verdict.rationale: Restate's flow-control docs explicitly support concurrency limits 'per scope' (service, virtual object/key) to protect downstream services and control cost (restate-docs-4, restate-docs-11, restate-docs-32, restate-docs-67), which covers the per-workflow/per-key concurrency-capping part of the story. However there's no explicit evidence of rate limiting (requests/sec throttling) as distinct from concurrency caps, nor any documented per-tenant scoping/isolation construct. Missing for 10: explicit rate-limit (not just concurrency) primitives, and documented per-tenant multi-tenancy fairness controls.
